title: NHDW seed-pack manifest
description: Declarative contract for a swappable, versioned NHDW seed pack. The seed ENGINE (bundle/scripts/seed-pack-engine, part of the system) reads this; the DATA (files referenced here) is the swappable pack. Changing seeds means shipping a new pack that conforms to this schema — never editing the system apps.

apiVersion.description: Manifest schema version this pack is written against.

seed_pack_version.description: This pack's own version (e.g. 2026.07.1). Bump it whenever the data changes.

targets_system.description: Version-range constraint on the DEPLOYED system this pack is compatible with (e.g. '>=1.4.0 <2.0.0'). The engine REFUSES to apply a pack whose range excludes the running system version — this is the fail-closed 'system won't break' guarantee. Space-separated constraints are ANDed; operators: >=, >, <=, <, ==, ~> (compatible-within-minor).

description.description: Human summary of what this pack seeds.

entries.description: Ordered list of seed operations. Entries run top-to-bottom; entries sharing a non-empty 'group' MAY run concurrently.

id.description: Unique, stable id for this entry (kebab-case).

target.description: Logical seed target the adapter resolves (e.g. ethioemr, ops_perm, keycloak, minio, gateway-api).

kind.description: Adapter that applies this entry. mysql-dump/sqlserver-bak/pg-dump = load a source-DB dump; sql = ordered SQL files into an app DB; kcadm = Keycloak realm/clients/users; mc = MinIO objects; api = call a system REST endpoint; csv = bulk-load CSV.

file.description: Single data file, relative to the pack root. Mutually exclusive with glob/dir.

glob.description: Glob of data files, relative to the pack root. Use 'order' to pin sequence. Mutually exclusive with file/dir.

dir.description: Directory of data, relative to the pack root. Mutually exclusive with file/glob.

order.description: Explicit filename order within a glob/dir (basenames). Files not listed run after, sorted.

group.description: Optional concurrency group. Entries with the same group value may run in parallel (e.g. independent source replicas).

when.description: Optional gate expression (e.g. 'topology==fleet'); reserved for env-conditional seeds.

oneOf.description: api/kcadm entries may carry their payload inline via target resolution and need no file.
